name: app.R
content:
# Example Shiny app structure
library(shiny)
library(tidyquant)
library(ggplot2)

ui <- fluidPage(
  # ... UI elements for inputting stock symbols, date ranges, etc.
  plotOutput("stock_chart")
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$stock_chart <- renderPlot({
    # Retrieve stock data using tq_get
    stock_data <- tq_get("AAPL", get = "stock.prices",
                         from = Sys.Date()-365, to = Sys.Date())
    
    # Create a financial chart
    stock_data %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = date, y = adjusted)) +
      geom_line() +
      theme_tq() + # Apply tidyquant theme
      labs(title = paste(input$symbol, "Stock Prices"))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

name: app_upload.R
content:
# ui.R
library(shiny)
library(tidyquant)
ui = fluidPage(
  titlePanel("File Upload Example"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      fileInput("upload_file", "Choose CSV File",
                accept = c(".csv", ".txt")), # Optional: limit accepted file types
      tags$hr(), # Add a horizontal rule for visual separation
      checkboxInput("header", "Header", TRUE), # Option for header presence
      radioButtons("sep", "Separator",
                   choices = c(Comma = ",",
                               Semicolon = ";",
                               Tab = "\t"),
                   selected = ",")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      tableOutput("contents"), # Output to display the uploaded data
      DTOutput("this")
    )
  )
)
server <- function(input, output) {
  
  output$contents <- renderTable({
    # req() ensures that the code below only runs when a file is uploaded
    req(input$upload_file)
    
    # Read the uploaded file based on user's choices
    df <- read.csv(input$upload_file$datapath,
                   header = input$header,
                   sep = input$sep)
    return(df)
  })
  output$this = renderDT({
    aapl_prices <- tq_get("AAPL", get = "stock.prices")
    
    # Print the data
    aapl_prices
    
  })
}
shinyApp(ui, server, options = list(launch.browser = TRUE,port = 2030))
